name: Input
description: Single-line text input with a two-column horizontal form layout. Label (40%) and input (60%) share a 20px gap. Hover and focus states implemented.

root.description: Outer wrapper. Owns total component width. Hosts .formRow in horizontal layout.

formRow.description: CSS Grid — 40% label col | 20px column-gap | 1fr field col. align-items: start so label wraps downward and input stays fixed.

label.description: Left column in horizontal layout. padding-top: 7px aligns its first text line with the input's vertical centre.

fieldColumn.description: Right column. Flex column stacking inputWrapper and helperText.

inputWrapper.description: The visible bordered box. Receives :hover, :focus-within, and data-state for visual states. Future prefix/suffix icon slots live here.

input.description: Bare input element. Transparent background, fills the wrapper.

helperText.description: Assistive copy below the field. Linked via aria-describedby.

layout.inputWidthNote: 390px is the fixed reference; the total form width is derived from it
layout.labelAlignmentNote: text-align: right — label text sits flush against the input

size.defaultWidthNote: total component width: 260px label + 20px gap + 390px input

placeholder.typographyNote: identical to input value typography — only color differs

requiredIndicator.type: CSS ::before pseudo-element on .inputWrapper[data-required] — no extra DOM node
requiredIndicator.reusable: add data-required to any position:relative form control wrapper to apply the same indicator
requiredIndicator.widthNote: 3px content-box width + 3px border-left = 6px total element rendered
requiredIndicator.height: full height of inputWrapper via top:0; bottom:0

position.left: -1px — overlaps the 1px left border so the accent color fully replaces it
position.note: bar sits on top of the border, not inside the padding area

requiredIndicator.interiorLayout: | border (covered by bar, 1px) | 3px bar | 2px gap | 10px padding | text
requiredIndicator.borderRadius: 4px 0 0 4px — chosen to avoid CSS radius scaling constraint (sum of adjacent radii ≤ element width, i.e. 4+0=4 ≤ 6px)

color.TODO: Add --ds-components-input-required-accent: #FF5D5A to color.json. Hex matches --ds-components-input-error-outline but the tokens are semantically distinct.

requiredIndicator.trigger: data-required attribute on .inputWrapper; set when required={true}
requiredIndicator.accessibility: CSS pseudo-element — not in the accessibility tree; required attribute on <input> announces to screen readers
requiredIndicator.inputPaddingLeft: 15px when required (padding-left override on .input) — 3px bar + 2px gap + 10px base

suffixSlot.sizeNote: 32×32px square; wrapper 1px padding (top/right/bottom) keeps slot inset from the border so it appears centred

background.TODO: map to a design token once the icon-slot background is added to color.json

suffixSlot.borderRadius: 0 5px 5px 0 — follows wrapper's 6px outer radius minus 1px border
suffixSlot.alignment: center — icon centred horizontally and vertically within the slot
suffixSlot.trigger: data-has-suffix attribute on .inputWrapper; set when suffix prop is provided
suffixSlot.wrapperPadding: 1px 1px 1px 0 when suffix present — 1px gap around icon from border; left stays 0 for required indicator
suffixSlot.accessibility: aria-hidden='true' on the slot span — decorative; interactive icons need their own accessible label

error.focusShadow: none — border-only feedback in error state
error.implementation: error prop on Input → data-variant='error' on .root → CSS cascade

disabled.implementation: rootVariant derived from inputProps.disabled; data-variant='disabled' on .root → CSS cascade

suffix.note: icon or element for the 32px right-side slot

accessibility.labelledBy: htmlFor/id pair — id is auto-generated via React useId() when not provided
accessibility.describedBy: aria-describedby links helperText span to the input
accessibility.requiredIndicator: decorative CSS ::before accent bar — no aria-hidden needed (pseudo-element is not in the accessibility tree); required attribute on <input> announces to screen readers
accessibility.keyboardNavigation: native — Tab to focus, Shift+Tab to blur
